_source: MMG_v19_Client_Manual_Testing_Guideline_FG05-FG14_v1.0.xlsx / Testing Guideline — the copy pulled from the client's Google Drive on 2026-09-16, now canonical in mmg/document. FG-12 'Fulfillment & Inventory Sync' holds 13 cases: TC-FUL-001 … TC-FUL-007, TC-FUL-009, TC-FUL-013 … TC-FUL-015, TC-FUL-017, TC-FUL-018. All 13 are implemented.
_target: Odoo 19 only. TC-FUL-013's central expectation — that Carrier and Tracking Reference go read-only once a delivery is CANCELLED — is new in the v19 port (multichannel_fulfillment/views/stock_picking_views.xml:31-40), and the Inventory Configuration tab the other cases walk is the v19 shape of the store form.
_safety: ecommerce.channel id 3 is the gallery's LIVE Shopify store, with inventory sync on. Every rule and exclusion this suite creates is scoped applied_on='0_product_variant' onto a scratch product the suite created, so it can never match one of the gallery's items (include_inventory_sync.is_product_matching keys on product_id equality). The only write made to the store's own configuration is TC-FUL-001's warehouse probe, which the check_active_warehouses constraint must refuse — and it restores what it found BEFORE it asserts anything. bulk_inventory_sync and do_update_shipment_to_channel are never called: both reach Shopify.
_residual_manual: Reading the Available figure off a real listing (TC-FUL-002/003/005 — needs a product.channel.variant mapping, which only an import from the store creates); pressing the bulk-update button (TC-FUL-009 steps 7-8 and 11, which the workbook itself forbids while sync is on); unticking Enable Export Shipment and pressing Update to Store (TC-FUL-014 steps 4-8); ticking the settings off against Novobi's FG-08 TC-CHN-001 printout (TC-FUL-001, TC-FUL-015).

_findings.BC-FG12-001: P0. stock.service.picking.action_confirm (multichannel_fulfillment/models/stock_service_picking.py:104) and stock.service.move.action_done (stock_service_move.py:134) both call float_is_zero(..., precision_digits=product_uom_id.rounding). uom.rounding is a float (0.001), not a digit count. v15's float_is_zero accepted anything and quietly evaluated 10**-0.001; v19 validates the argument and raises ValueError (odoo/tools/float_utils.py:170-174). Every Validate on every service transfer therefore dies before doing anything. Fix: precision_rounding= instead of precision_digits= in both places. Reported by TEST-FG12-FUL-017 and TEST-FG12-FUL-018, both of which FAIL on it. FIXED in psus-medicine-man-gallery 91ea498 (as BC-031): precision_digits= -> precision_rounding= at both sites. TEST-FG12-FUL-017 and -018 now PASS.
_findings.BC-FG12-002: P1. Confirming an order whose only lines are services fails with a NOT NULL violation on stock_service_move.date. Odoo 19's sale.order._compute_expected_date skips non-goods lines outright (addons/sale/models/sale_order.py:737-752); v15 took the minimum across every line (mmg_15/addons/sale/models/sale_order.py:332-345). StockServiceMove._get_stock_move_values still passes order.expected_date into stock.service.move.date, which is required=True (stock_service_move.py:16-18, 122). An order that also carries a goods line is unaffected. Fix: fall back to commitment_date or fields.Datetime.now() when expected_date is empty. Reported by TEST-FG12-FUL-017's last step. FIXED in psus-medicine-man-gallery 91ea498 (as BC-032): _get_stock_move_values falls back to sale_line_id._expected_date(). TEST-FG12-FUL-017's last step now PASSES.
_findings.OBS-FG12-001: ecommerce.channel._generate_exclude_domain is @api.private in v19 and cannot be called over RPC, so TC-FUL-005/006/007 assert the method's whole input (the o2m rows, their level and their targets) rather than the domain it returns. The child_of semantics TC-FUL-007 turns on are exercised directly through the ORM on the same operator and the same ids.

TC-FUL-001.reason: Settings surface, the company domain on the warehouse list, and the check_active_warehouses refusal, probed against the live store with an unconditional restore. This database holds ONE warehouse, so the workbook's multi-warehouse steps are N/A as it instructs.

TC-FUL-002.reason: The four Apply On levels, calc_available_qty at 50% and 10% of 20 on hand, the 0/150 refusals and the 0.01/100 boundaries, and the rule's deletion restoring the store's own rule set.

TC-FUL-003.reason: The three worked cases (100% capped at 5, 50% capped at 5, 10% floored at 8), the maximum-of-0 and negative-minimum refusals, and the three columns on the rules list.

TC-FUL-004.reason: Attempts A, B and C. The workbook says either answer to C is acceptable and that Novobi needs to know which: equal non-zero values are REFUSED (include_inventory_sync.py:126-129), and the case records that rather than asserting one way.

TC-FUL-005.reason: Three Apply On levels, the row's name and targets, survival across a reload, whether a duplicate is allowed (it is), and the exclusion list restored exactly.

TC-FUL-006.reason: The row names the variant and not the parent template, and holds that variant and no sibling — which is exactly the clause _generate_exclude_domain emits at the variant level.

TC-FUL-007.reason: Categories is a many2many that holds more than one; child_of reaches the child category and not an unrelated one; the precedence note is on the rule form.

TC-FUL-009.reason: The button's gating expression and its three states, the platform in its wording, and Last all inventory updated beside it. The press is not made: on THIS store none of bulk_inventory_sync's three guards would fire and the whole catalogue would be pushed to Shopify — the workbook's own step 11 forbids it too.

TC-FUL-013.reason: The four storefront fields present and populated on real deliveries, Requested Service read-only, and Carrier/Tracking Reference read-only on state in ['cancel'] — the v19 behaviour the case exists to check. Read-only throughout.

TC-FUL-014.reason: is_update_to_channel_needed is computed and requires an ID on Channel, sampled across storefront and hand-made deliveries. The refusal path is quoted from the guard rather than produced by switching the gallery's Enable Export Shipment off.

TC-FUL-015.reason: The setting is present, is ON, and is the flag do_update_shipment_to_channel reads. Whether it is platform-gated in the view is reported rather than asserted blind — this database holds one store and it is Shopify.

TC-FUL-017.reason: PASSES since 91ea498 fixed BC-FG12-001 and BC-FG12-002; it FAILED on both before that. Covers: the Other Fulfillments count and action, the read-only Partner, the three-state status bar, the four Items columns and their draft-only editability, and that the transfer holds the service line alone. The last step reports BC-FG12-002.

TC-FUL-018.reason: PASSES since 91ea498 fixed BC-FG12-001; before that the immediate-transfer pop-up could not be raised at all, because raising it IS action_confirm. The pop-up's own content and its two buttons are asserted from the wizard view.
